defects.catch_criteria: In tests/helpers/real-process-fixture.ts, harnessProcesses accepts a process on Windows when its command line names the root even if its environment lacks the release-harness marker (`marked || (process.platform === "win32" && namesDirectory(command, root))`), and stopHarnessProcesses kills everything harnessProcesses returns. A catch must say that on Windows an unmarked process whose command line names the sandbox root is found and killed, which breaks the stated rule that a process without the marker is never killed.
defects.title: Require the harness marker on Windows

defects.catch_criteria: In tests/helpers/real-process-fixture.ts, namesDirectory accepts whitespace as the boundary after the directory (`(?=$|[/\s"'])`), so a sibling directory whose name continues with a space, such as `<dir>/gate other`, matches root `<dir>/gate` in a command line or an environment value. A catch must say that a path whose next character after the root is a space inside a directory name is matched as the root, so a process of a different directory can be found and killed.
defects.title: Do not treat spaces inside directory names as path boundaries
